## KaliScriber 0.10.0

Install the `arm64-v8a` APK on most phones (`universal` if unsure). It updates over earlier builds and keeps your meetings and settings.

### Meetings
- **Since last time.** A meeting with the same title (dates and numbers aside) or the same calendar event as an earlier one shows what that meeting decided and which of its action items are still open or done since, with a link back to it.
- **Talk time.** Each person's share of the talking, how often they took the floor, the questions they asked and their longest stretch, with initials avatars.
- **Your own summary formats.** Settings → Summary formats:
  - give a format a name, the kind of meeting it is for and the sections you want, or start from a built-in one;
  - pick it on any meeting's Summary tab, next to the built-in formats;
  - or give it title words so matching meetings use it by themselves.
- **Share a clip.** Highlights and bookmarks have a share button, and selected transcript lines have *Share clip*. The stretch of audio (20 seconds either side of a highlight, mostly before a bookmark, or the selected lines) is sent as a small M4A with what was said in it. Without a recording, the words are shared on their own.

### Recording
- **Interruptions are noticed.** When a phone call or another app takes the microphone, the recording screen and notification say so. The gap is marked in the transcript and exports, and the AI is told nothing was recorded then.

### Ask all meetings
- **Filters.** Limit a question to the last week, month, three months or year, to meetings with one person, or to one summary format. Only those meetings are searched, and each question shows the filters it was asked with.

### Export
- **Markdown folder.** Settings → Export destinations → Markdown folder:
  - pick a folder, such as an Obsidian vault, and every finished meeting gets a Markdown note there;
  - each note has properties Obsidian reads (date, people, format, open actions, tags), then the notes and, optionally, the transcript;
  - notes are rewritten when a meeting changes, renamed with it and removed when it's deleted, and their names stay stable so links keep working.

### Look and accessibility
- **Light, dark or the phone's setting**, and whether colours come from your wallpaper (Settings → Appearance).
- Speaker colours are lighter in dark mode so names stay readable.
- Screen readers hear each setting's switch and description as one control, card titles and date groups as headings, and what tapping or holding a transcript line does.
